name: io.github.Guoqiang1006/gomami-mcp
title: GoMami (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for GoMami and other VirtFusion VPS panels, read-only by default

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token. Optional if the token is saved in ~/.config/gomami-mcp (see GOMAMI_TOKEN_FILE)

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_MCP_ACCESS
environmentVariables.description: Access tier: read, operate or full

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_MCP_PROTECTED_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated server IDs that can be read but not changed

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: VirtFusion panel API URL (https only). Defaults to GoMami: https://cp.gomami.io/api

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Token file path. Defaults to ~/.config/gomami-mcp/token for GoMami and token-<host> for other panels
